english.title: Pilot fail to cause information to be given to CAA / competent authority of departure from SERA / Rules of the Air
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the pilot in command of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), when a departure from

(A)_[the Rules of the Air,]_
(B)_[an obligation in SERA,]_

the breach of which would otherwise be an offence under the Air Navigation Order 2016, was made for the purpose of avoiding immediate danger, failed to cause to be given without delay, and in any event within 10 days of the departure, written detailed information about the departure and the circumstances giving rise to it to the

(C)_[competent authority of **(..SPECIFY COUNTRY..), the country in whose territory the departure was made]_
(D)_[CAA, the departure having been made over the high seas]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 249(5) and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
